get_oobb_from_mujoco_body: get an oriented bounding box for a given MuJoCo body index from a model and data
overlap_oobb_oobb: test whether two oriented bounding boxes overlap using the separating axis theorem
overlap_aabb_oobb: test whether an axis-aligned bounding box and an oriented bounding box overlap
transform_oobb: apply a translation and rotation transform to an oriented bounding box
get_vertices_oobb: get the 8 corner vertices of an oriented bounding box as a numpy array
